name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
description: Institutional credit facility providing adequate and timely credit to farmers for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, working capital, and farm asset maintenance at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum with prompt repayment incentive.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
benefits: Revolving agricultural credit facility up to Rs. 3,00,000 (sub-limit Rs. 2,00,000 for allied activities). Statutory lending structure: Banks extend credit at a benchmark concessional rate of 7% p.a. (supported by 1.5% institutional interest subvention from GoI to banks under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme - MISS). Farmers who repay on or before the due date (tenor up to 1 year) receive a 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI), resulting in an effective net interest rate of 4% p.a. If repayment is delayed beyond the due date, the 3% PRI is forfeited and the borrower is charged the full 7% p.a. rate. Collateral-free credit is available up to Rs. 1.60 Lakh.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare in coordination with RBI and NABARD.
